preregistration.name: rho CrB c Milestone 20 held-out detector-v0.5 validation
preregistration.scientific_target: An intermittent narrowband signal coherent under the selected rho CrB c motion hypothesis; the signal is not assumed to originate on the planet or to be aimed at Earth
preregistration.selection_rule: Advance rho CrB at frozen discovery rank 10 after rank 8 47 UMa was searched and rank 9 HD 48948 proved S-band-only; search the sole complete cadence --71771 after all metadata and full-bank coverage checks pass.
preregistration.survey_scope: New target, cadence, date, and spectral payload. No second complete compatible cadence exists in the frozen screen. Telescope, five search bands, recurrence statistic, thresholds, spectral widths, orbital scale/phase bank, RFI mask, detector-v0.5 vetoes, empirical calibration, and completeness procedure remain frozen.

global_result.assessment: FOLLOW-UP REQUIRED: significance and OFF-source evidence must be reviewed manually.

completeness.method: Real m20_1412p5 planet-frame noise vectors are independently circularly shifted by epoch; signals use time-averaged sinc-squared leakage and model acceleration within each integration.
completeness.ideal_snr_definition: Single-epoch S/N the same total signal power would produce as a stationary bin-centred one-channel tone.

interpretation_limits: This search covers 5 disjoint planet-frame bands totaling 5 MHz, not the full receiver band.
A null result constrains only signals present in at least two of the three epochs and represented by the orbital template bank.
The 1/3/5/9-channel boxcars approximate, but do not exactly match, every fractional-bin and acceleration-smeared line shape.
Completeness is measured for exact orbital-bank templates active in epochs 1 and 3; it is not yet marginalized over orbital-model error or every duty cycle.
When configured, the recurrence guard requires every claimed active epoch to exceed its stated single-epoch S/N floor.
The strong-single-epoch RFI mask and recurrence statistic were added after the first Milestone 7 diagnostic run; independent future bands are required for confirmation.
The per-epoch RFI mask follows each circularly shifted epoch in the empirical null and completeness trials.
Scramble p-values are empirical ranks with resolution 1/(N+1), not Gaussian sigma conversions.
